CREATE TABLE ultrabrain.memory_policies (
 source_id text NOT NULL REFERENCES public.sources(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, slug text NOT NULL,
 revision integer NOT NULL CHECK(revision>0), status text NOT NULL CHECK(status IN ('active','retracted','superseded','review_required')),
 assertion_kind text NOT NULL CHECK(assertion_kind IN ('attributed','source_quote','inference')),
 content_sha256 text NOT NULL CHECK(length(content_sha256)=64), valid_from timestamptz,valid_until timestamptz,
 replacement_slug text,replacement_sha256 text,updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
 PRIMARY KEY(source_id,slug),CHECK(valid_from IS NULL OR valid_until IS NULL OR valid_until>valid_from))

CREATE TABLE ultrabrain.memory_policy_history (
 source_id text NOT NULL,slug text NOT NULL,revision integer NOT NULL,event_id text NOT NULL,
 request_hash text NOT NULL,actor_key text NOT NULL,snapshot jsonb NOT NULL CHECK(jsonb_typeof(snapshot)='object'),
 created_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),PRIMARY KEY(source_id,slug,revision),UNIQUE(source_id,slug,event_id),
 FOREIGN KEY(source_id,slug) REFERENCES ultrabrain.memory_policies ON DELETE CASCADE)

CREATE TRIGGER ultrabrain_memory_policy_native_change AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON public.pages
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ultrabrain.invalidate_memory_policy()

CREATE FUNCTION ultrabrain.invalidate_policy_summaries() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql SET search_path=pg_catalog,public AS $f$
BEGIN DELETE FROM ultrabrain.summary_cache WHERE source_id=NEW.source_id AND slug=NEW.slug;RETURN NEW;END $f$

CREATE TRIGGER ultrabrain_policy_summary_invalidation AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE ON ultrabrain.memory_policies
FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION ultrabrain.invalidate_policy_summaries()
